purpose: Link Cognitive IQ Lab sessions to externally administered validation measures without storing protected item content or scoring keys.

fields.sourceKey: Pseudonymous participant/source key matching the CIL calibration export.
fields.sessionId: CIL session identifier to link common-person evidence.
fields.instrumentId: Versioned identifier such as ICAR-controlled-v1 or another approved validation instrument.
fields.administrationId: External platform/research administration identifier with no direct identity information.
fields.ageYears: Whole-year age only, matching the CIL supported range when applicable.
fields.externalScoreType: raw, theta, standardized, percentile, or instrument-defined score type.
fields.externalScore: Numeric score from the controlled external administration.
fields.externalStandardError: Optional uncertainty/SE supplied by the external instrument.
fields.externalReliability: Optional reliability estimate documented for the external score.
fields.licenseRecord: Reference to the permission/license/registration governing use of the external instrument.
fields.itemContentStored: Must be false for instruments whose terms prohibit publication/storage in this repository.
fields.scoringKeyStored: Must be false for protected scoring keys.
fields.notes: Optional research note without personal identifiers.
